latitude.tooltip: Decimal degrees, positive north (default: West Lafayette, IN)

longitude.tooltip: Decimal degrees, negative west (default: West Lafayette, IN)

refresh-interval.tooltip: How often to re-download the SPC Day 1 outlook

display-mode.tooltip: When there is no risk, a white checkmark icon is always shown; the NONE text follows the setting below (and is hidden in Icon only mode)

show-none-label.description: Show NONE when there is no risk
show-none-label.tooltip: Show the text NONE next to the checkmark when your location has no thunderstorm risk. Turn off for icon only.

test-point.tooltip: Uses the bundled archived High Risk outlook instead of live data, at a city inside the chosen category. Ignores your latitude/longitude. Set back to Off for real data.
